items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: he played the piano...he would always teach me different songs

ctx.x: So I...uh...my...a friend of mine, Uncle Charlie--I call him Uncle Charlie--he played the piano...he would always teach me different songs, like I said before, so sometimes I'd go down there and, "Play and let me sing."
Say, "You better get back up on them steps."
